notes: Fix: adding a set could remove another one. The delete handler was attached to the x between weight and reps, so tapping it silently deleted the set while the X button did nothing. The X button now deletes, and the x sign is inert

Fix: a set added through the shorthand box, or from imported notes, was stored in pounds while the app works in kilograms. Its tonnage and e1RM read about 2.2x too high for anyone on lb. Hand-typed sets were correct, which is why the two disagreed
Fix: after any redraw a weight you had already typed could come back as a long decimal, e.g. 180 lb showing as 81.64662740915384
New: a + Add set button. With the box filled it reads your shorthand, empty it just adds a line for you to fill in
Set rows now fit on one line on a phone, so the delete button no longer wraps underneath
